candidates.title: Dune ripper
candidates.summary: Side-view amber glass skiff facing left, bone rail, double row of glass teeth, rose sail, and two stern thrusters.
limitations: Concept art only. Not registered in the runtime.
The alpha matte is binary. Edge color is bled into nearby zero-alpha pixels so filtering does not revive the green key.
The sail is rose cloth with dark ribs. It is not a glass plate.
Tooth count is whatever the canonical image shows. It was not reduced to a single number.
Silhouette was checked on a flattened preview at about 112 px of body width, on white and near-black, not in the game.

candidates.title: Glass manta
candidates.summary: Top-down amber glass manta facing down, wide wings, a rose helm core, and trailing glass barbs.
limitations: Concept art only. Not registered in the runtime.
Wing translucency is painted as pale stained glass. The wings are opaque, so they stay readable at about 60 px of body width.
The keyed sprite was scaled by 744/935 inside the canvas so each wingtip has about 140 px of padding. That inset left a thin partial-alpha rim.
The trailing barbs soften at about 60 px of body width. The wings and helm still read.
Silhouette was checked on a flattened preview at about 60 px of body width, on white and near-black, not in the game.
